en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, raising it, said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one who marries his daughter to a drinker of the wine, so he has cut off his relationship’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from in a marfu’ manner has said the following: “
Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘If one gives his daughter in marriage to a man who drinks wine, he has cut off the relation that relatives are commanded to maintain.’”
